opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their PhD in a historical subject to a UK institution; normally resident in the UK; not in full-time permanent academic employment; current members of the Royal Historical Society; current doctoral students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £2,000 for discrete career-building research projects lasting no more than six months, enabling researchers to produce a discrete outcome such as an article or book proposal.

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship in African History
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD in African history; research projects clearly and predominantly historical with a specific chronological remit; previous Martin Lynn Scholarship holders not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of £1,500 to support the doctoral research of a postgraduate researcher in African history.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants, 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Historians who are members of the Royal Historical Society and are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (within 5 years of completing a PhD); research projects clearly and predominantly historical with a specific chronological remit.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to support historians without access to research funding to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend conferences.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History; proposed research historical in nature with a clearly defined chronological remit; not open to those who have completed a doctoral degree.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to support postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not for conference attendance).

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected PhD in a historical subject, who are current members of the Royal Historical Society; not open to postgraduate research students or those more than five years beyond PhD submission.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 or £1,000 to support early career historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews (not for conference attendance).

opportunities.title: David Berry Fellowship in the History of Scotland and the Scottish People
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current members of the Royal Historical Society at all career stages (from PhD research and beyond); supported by a referee; able to undertake research within 12 months of the closing date of the next application round.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of up to £2,500 to undertake research on the history of Scotland and the Scottish people worldwide, including travel, accommodation and archive costs.

opportunities.title: RHS Workshop Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Fellows or members of the Royal Historical Society acting as lead organisers; funds support travel, venue hire, hospitality and overnight accommodation, and travel bursaries for public events.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £1,000 to enable historians to come together to pursue projects of shared interest, hosting a day event covering research discussion, teaching practice development, grant planning, networking, etc.
